notes: Maker page contradicts itself on class: header says 'CLASS 1 & CLASS 2; CLASS 3 READY' while the spec list says 'Class 1 - 20mph Pedal Assist'; it has a twist throttle, so recorded as Class 2 (EBR: 'Class 1 / Class 2 as shipped; dealer-enabled Class 3'). Maker rider height 5'4"-6'1" vs EBR 5'1"-6'1". EBR review is model year 2026, same specs. A second 'Latch 2' card on the Latch page shows $2,195 / 90 miles (likely another variant), not used.
